transcript.content: Hello. I'm a psychiatrist here, and I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to the clinic?

I'm visiting today because my mind has been racing constantly and I have this overwhelming amount of energy that I just can't seem to control. On top of that, I've been hearing voices that other people tell me aren't actually there.
Have you ever heard these voices during times when your energy levels and mood felt completely normal, rather than high or racing?

Yes, I actually have. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood and energy felt completely normal and stable, but I was still hearing those voices. They don't just happen when I'm feeling high or full of energy.
How long have you been dealing with these voices in total, and for how much of that time have you also felt that high energy or racing mind?

I've been hearing the voices for about four months in total, while the high energy and racing thoughts have lasted for about six months. For almost all of the time I heard the voices, I also had that high energy, except for those two weeks. Overall, I've been dealing with these mental health struggles for about a year and two months now.
You mentioned dealing with these struggles for about a year and two months. What difficulties or symptoms were you experiencing during the months when you did not have high energy or hear voices?

During those other times, which lasted for about two months, I felt extremely down, sad, and completely empty inside. I lost all motivation and interest in the things I used to enjoy, and I just wanted to isolate myself from everyone.

No, I didn't really notice or experience those kinds of symptoms, like a complete lack of emotion or drive, when my mood was stable. During those times, my motivation and feelings felt pretty much back to normal.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or medications, or do you have any medical conditions that could be causing these experiences?
No, I don't use any recreational drugs, drink alcohol, or take any medications. I also don't have any medical conditions that could explain why I've been experiencing these things.
Could you tell me more about those strange beliefs you mentioned, or what exactly you experienced when you felt you were being watched?

Yes, I am absolutely certain that I am being constantly watched and monitored. I have this persistent fear that a specific organization is tracking my movements and spying on me to try and cause me harm. It’s terrifying because I can feel them following me and watching my every move, no matter where I go.
